goals.objective: Modify /Users/shinyoohag/Desktop/frametrace. Goal: make gui/evidence-viewer first screen look and behave like a Windows local forensic video evidence review tool used by field examiners. First review README, docs, gui/evidence-viewer, and src CLI structure. Improve first-screen IA so evidence sources, video candidates, validation status, export, and report flow are visible at a glance. Copy must avoid exaggerated release wording and clearly show local-first, verification required, candidate-unvalidated, and similar forensic statuses. Rust engine changes only if necessary and minimal. Preserve existing dirty worktree; do not revert unrelated changes. Verification: cargo test possible range, browser QA at 375/768/1280, screenshots under .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ui-ia/.

successCriteria.scenario: Viewer-first happy path: serve gui/evidence-viewer with python3 -m http.server 4177 --directory gui/evidence-viewer, open http://127.0.0.1:4177/index.html in Playwright Chromium at 1280x900, assert the first screen prioritizes the video/recovered-material viewer and visible candidate table while retaining compact review-critical state text: Evidence sources, Video candidates, Validation queue, Export preview, Report package, local-first, verification required, and candidate-unvalidated; capture desktop-1280.png and playwright-assertions.json.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ui-ia/desktop-1280.png plus playwright-assertions.json showing viewer-first layout, visible candidate rows, and required review-state text.
successCriteria.notes: Playwright 1280x900 shows viewer-first layout, visible candidate rows, compact Evidence sources/Video candidates/Validation queue/Export preview/Report package states, local-first, verification required, candidate-unvalidated; pageErrors empty.

successCriteria.scenario: Responsive edge path: serve gui/evidence-viewer with python3 -m http.server 4177 --directory gui/evidence-viewer, open page in Playwright Chromium at 375x900 and 768x900, assert no horizontal overflow, first workflow summary remains visible above the inventory table, and status-honest labels local-first, verification required, candidate-unvalidated are visible; capture screenshots mobile-375.png and tablet-768.png plus overflow log responsive-overflow.json.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ui-ia/mobile-375.png, tablet-768.png, and responsive-overflow.json showing overflow=false for both widths.
successCriteria.notes: Playwright 375x900 and 768x900 show no horizontal overflow, visible review-state labels, and visible rendered candidate rows; mobile/tablet keep the viewer before lower-priority workflow controls.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression auxiliary path: run cargo test for the GUI-adjacent/report/validation scope that is feasible in this dirty worktree, starting with cargo test --lib, and capture exact command output to .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ui-ia/cargo-test-lib.txt. If existing dirty-worktree failures occur outside changed UI scope, record failing test names and do not revert unrelated files.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/frametrace-ui-ia/cargo-test-lib.txt with exit code and summary; pass if clean, otherwise explicit pre-existing/non-UI failure classification.
successCriteria.notes: cargo test --lib passed with 159 passed, 0 failed; node syntax checks and browser QA logs passed for changed GUI surface; Rust engine was not changed for the viewer-first follow-up.
